title: 根门防护
note: 见闻觉知中不取相不取随相

evidence.pali: 463 . ‘‘Iti kho, ānanda, desitā mayā ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā, desito sekho pāṭipado, desito ariyo bhāvitindriyo . Yaṃ kho, ānanda, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā. Etāni, ānanda, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni, jhāyathānanda, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī’’ti.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 463. 阿难，如是，我已于圣律中开示了无上诸根修习，开示了行道之有学，开示了诸根已修习之圣者。阿难，寻求弟子们利益、具怜悯心的导师，出于怜悯所应做之事，我已为你们做了。阿难，这些是树下，这些是空寂处。阿难，你们当禅修，不要放逸，莫要日后追悔。这是我们对你们的教诫。
evidence.english: 463. Thus, Ānanda, I have taught the unsurpassed development of the faculties in the Noble One’s Discipline; I have taught the learner on the path; I have taught the noble one with developed faculties. Whatever should be done, Ānanda, by a teacher out of compassion, seeking the welfare of his disciples, that has been done by me for you. These, Ānanda, are the roots of trees; these are empty dwellings. Meditate, Ānanda, do not be negligent, lest you have remorse later. This is our instruction to you.

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Indriyesū ti idamassa guttadvāratāya bhūmiparidīpanaṃ; rakkhitabbokāsaparidīpanantipi vadanti eva. Guttadvāro ti idamassa chasu dvāresu saṃvihitārakkhabhāvaparidīpanaṃ. Bhojane mattaññū ti idamassa santosādiguṇaparidīpanaṃ. Pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto ti idamassa kāraṇabhāvaparidīpanaṃ. Sātaccaṃ nepakka nti idamassa paññāpariggahitena vīriyena sātaccakāritāparidīpanaṃ . Bodhipakkhikānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto ti idamassa paṭipattiyā nibbedhabhāgiyattaparidīpanaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘于诸根’，此为阐明其守护根门的基础；亦有人说，是阐明应守护之处。‘守护根门’，此为阐明其于六门设置守护的状态。‘饮食知量’，此为阐明知足等功德。‘于初夜后夜致力于保持清醒’，此为阐明其作为助因的状态。‘恒常、审慎’，此为阐明以慧所摄的精进持续行事。‘致力于修习菩提分法’，此为阐明其行道朝向决择。
entries.english: “In the sense faculties” illuminates the ground for his guardedness of the doors; some also say it illuminates the occasion for guarding. “Guarded in the doors” illuminates his well-protected state at the six doors. “Moderate in eating” illuminates his qualities such as contentment. “Devoted to wakefulness in the first and last watches of the night” illuminates his diligence. “Perseverance and clear comprehension” illuminates his constant activity with energy encompassed by wisdom. “Devoted to the practice of the qualities conducive to enlightenment” illuminates his practice as being of the nature of penetration.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Api ca idha bhikkhū ti imasmiṃ sāsane jhānuppādako bhikkhu. Idāni yasmā jhānuppādakena bhikkhunā cattāri sīlāni sodhetabbāni, tasmāssa pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto ti iminā pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlavisuddhiṃ upadisati. Ācāragocarasampanno tiādinā ājīvapārisuddhisīlaṃ. Samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesū ti iminā tesaṃ dvinnaṃ sīlānaṃ anavasesato ādānaṃ. Indriyesu guttadvāro ti iminā indriyasaṃvarasīlaṃ. Bhojane mattaññū ti iminā paccayasannissitasīlaṃ. Pubbarattāpararatta ntiādinā sīle patiṭṭhitassa jhānabhāvanāya upakārake dhamme. So abhikkante tiādinā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aparihānāya kammaṭṭhānassa ca asammosāya satisampajaññasamāyogaṃ. So vivitta ntiādinā bhāvanānurūpasenāsanapariggahaṃ. So araññagato vā tiādinā taṃ senāsanaṃ upagatassa jhānānurūpairiyāpathañceva jhānabhāvanārambhañca. So abhijjha ntiādinā jhānabhāvanārambhena jhānapaccanīkadhammappahānaṃ. So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāyā tiādinā evaṃ pahīnajjhānapaccanīkadhammassa sabbajjhānānaṃ uppattikkamaṃ upadisatīti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，‘于此，有比丘’，是指于此教法中能生起禅那的比丘。由于能生起禅那的比丘应清净四种戒，因此，以‘以波罗提木叉律仪而防护’开示波罗提木叉律仪戒的清净；以‘具足正行与行处’等开示活命遍净戒；以‘受持诸学处而学’开示对该二戒的无遗漏受持；以‘守护根门’开示根律仪戒；以‘饮食知量’开示资具依止戒；以‘于初夜后夜’等开示安住于戒而对禅修有助益的法；以‘彼于前进时’等开示为令彼等法不退、业处不乱而与念、正知相应；以‘彼受用远离的’等开示受用适合禅修的坐卧处；以‘彼或往森林’等开示已至彼坐卧处者适合禅修的威仪及禅修的开始；以‘彼舍断贪欲’等开示以禅修的开始舍断对禅那的障碍法；以‘彼舍断此五盖’等开示如是舍断禅那障碍法者一切禅那的生起次第。
entries.english: Furthermore, here, 'a bhikkhu' refers to a bhikkhu who develops jhāna in this Dispensation. Now, because a bhikkhu who develops jhāna must purify the fourfold virtue, therefore, 'restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint' indicates the purification of virtue through the Pātimokkha restraint. 'Accomplished in conduct and resort' indicates the purification of livelihood. 'Undertakes and trains in the training rules' signifies the complete undertaking of these two virtues. 'Guarded in the sense-doors' indicates the virtue of sense restraint. 'Knowing moderation in food' indicates the virtue dependent on the requisites. 'The first watch of the night and the last watch of the night,' and so on, refers to the qualities supportive of jhāna development for one established in virtue. 'In going forward,' and so on, refers to the application of mindfulness and clear comprehension to prevent the decline of these qualities and confusion regarding the meditation subject. 'He frequents a secluded dwelling,' and so on, refers to the selection of a dwelling suitable for meditation. 'Having gone to the forest,' and so on, refers to the posture suitable for jhāna and the commencement of jhāna development for one who has approached that dwelling. 'Having given up covetousness,' and so on, refers to the abandonment of factors opposed to jhāna through the commencement of jhāna development. 'Having abandoned these five hindrances,' and so on, indicates the progressive order of attainment of all the jhānas for one who has thus abandoned the factors opposed to jhāna.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: 517-8 . Indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū tipadadvayassa niddese kaṇhapakkhassa paṭhamavacane payojanaṃ ācāraniddese vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ. Tattha katamā indriyesu aguttadvāratā tiādīsu pana yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ nikkhepakaṇḍavaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttameva.
entries.chinese_simplified: 关于‘守护诸根门’与‘饮食知量’二词的解释，其在黑品初说中的作用，应依照先前于行仪解释中所说之理了知。至于‘何为于诸根不守护门’等所应说者，皆已于总结品释义中说明。
entries.english: 517-8. In the exposition of the two terms, 'guarded as to the doors of the senses' and 'knowing moderation in food,' the purpose in the first statement of the dark fortnight should be understood in the same way as explained in the exposition on conduct. As to this, whatever should be said concerning such questions as, 'What is unguardedness as to the doors of the senses?' and so on, all that has already been stated in the commentary on the Section on Summary.

entries.pali: Guttā satikavāṭena pidahitā dvārā etenāti guttadvāro ti āha ‘‘chasu indriyesū’’ tiādi . Pariyesanapaṭiggaṇhanaparibhogavissajjanavasena bhojane mattaṃ jānātīti bhojane mattaññū. Sama nti avisamaṃ. Samacāritā hi kāyavisamādīni pahāya kāyasamādipūraṇaṃ. Nisajjāyā ti ettha iti -saddo ādiattho, tena ‘‘āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhetī’’ti evamādiṃ saṅgaṇhāti. Bhāvanāya cittaparisodhanañhi jāgariyānuyogo, na niddāvinodanamattaṃ. Nittandī ti vigatathinamiddho. Sā pana nittanditā kāyālasiyavigamane pākaṭā hotīti vuttaṃ ‘‘kāyālasiyavirahito’’ ti. ‘‘Āraddhavīriyo’’ ti iminā duvidhopi vīriyārambho gahitoti taṃ vibhajitvā dassetuṃ ‘‘kāyikavīriyenāpī’’ tiādi vuttaṃ. Saṅgamma gaṇavihāro sahavāso saṅgaṇikā, sā pana kilesehipi evaṃ hotīti tato visesetuṃ ‘‘gaṇasaṅgaṇika’’ nti vuttaṃ. Gaṇena saṅgaṇikaṃ gaṇasaṅgaṇikanti. Ārambhavatthuvasenā ti anadhigatavisesādhigamakāraṇavasena ekavihārī, na kevalaṃ ekībhāvavasena. Kilesasaṅgaṇika nti kilesasahitacittataṃ. Yathā tathā ti vipassanāvasena, paṭisaṅkhānavasena vā. Samathavasena ārammaṇūpanijjhānaṃ. Vipassanāvasena lakkhaṇūpanijjhānaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 以念为门闩，关闭诸根门，故为“守护诸根(guttadvāro)”，故说“于六根中”等。通过寻求、接受、食用、舍弃的方式，于饮食知其量，故为“饮食知量者(bhojane mattaññū)”。“正直(Samaṃ)”即不偏颇(avisamaṃ)。“正直行(Samacāritā)”即舍弃身不正等，圆满身正直等。于“静坐时(Nisajjāya)”，此处的‘iti’字为起始义，由此概括“以[去除]五盖法净化其心”等内容。通过修习净化其心，即是“勤修觉醒(jāgariyānuyogo)”，不仅是驱除睡眠而已。“无昏沉者(Nittandī)”即远离昏沉睡眠(thīnamiddha)。此无昏沉的状态在远离身体懈怠时显现，故说“远离身体懈怠”。“发起精进(Āraddhavīriyo)”一词包含两种精进的发起，为分别显示，故说“以身精进亦”等。聚会、团体生活、共住，是为“乐众(saṅgaṇikā)”。然而此亦可与烦恼共存，为作区分，故说“与众乐众(gaṇasaṅgaṇika)”。与团体一起乐众，即是“与众乐众”。以发起之因为，即以证得未得之殊胜法为因而“独住(ekavihārī)”，不仅是独自一人而已。“烦恼乐众(Kilesasaṅgaṇikaṃ)”即与烦恼相应的心。“如其所是(Yathā tathā)”即通过观(vipassanā)，或通过省察(paṭisaṅkhāna)。以止(samatha)的方式是“所缘审察(ārammaṇūpanijjhāna)”。以观(vipassanā)的方式是“相审察(lakkhaṇūpanijjhāna)”。
entries.english: 'The doors are guarded by this,' that is, closed by the latch of mindfulness, hence one is called 'one with guarded doors'; thus it is said, 'in the six sense faculties,' and so on. One who knows the measure in eating by way of seeking, receiving, consuming, and disposing is 'one who knows the measure in eating.' 'Even' (samaṃ) means not uneven. For even conduct is the abandoning of bodily imbalance and so on and the fulfilling of bodily balance and so on. In 'in sitting,' the word 'iti' has the meaning of 'and so on'; thereby it includes such phrases as 'purifies the mind from obstructive states.' For the practice of wakefulness is the purification of the mind through cultivation, not merely the dispelling of sleep. 'Nittandīti' means free from sloth and torpor. And that freedom from sloth becomes manifest in the removal of bodily laziness, so it is said, 'free from bodily laziness.' By 'with aroused energy,' both kinds of arousal of energy are included; to show this by analyzing it, it is said, 'with bodily energy also,' and so on. Association (saṅgaṇikā) is dwelling in a group, living together, by coming together. But since this can also occur with defilements, to distinguish from that, it is said 'group-association' (gaṇasaṅgaṇika). Group-association means association with a group. 'By way of the object of striving' means one dwells alone for the sake of attaining as-yet-unattained distinctions, not merely for the sake of being alone. 'Association with defilements' means a state of mind accompanied by defilements. 'In whatever way' means by way of insight or by way of reflection. By way of serenity, it is sustained attention on the object. By way of insight, it is sustained attention on the characteristics.

entries.pali: Anulomapaṭipadāya paripūrakārī ti yā sā sīlādikā vipassanantā dukkhanirodhagāminiyā lokuttarāya paṭipadāya anulomanato anulomapaṭipadā, tassā sampādanena paripūrakārīti. Idāni taṃ paṭipadaṃ puggalādhiṭṭhānena dassetuṃ ‘‘sīlasampanno’’ tiādi vuttaṃ. Tattha sīlasampanno ti pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlena samannāgato, paripuṇṇapātimokkhasīlo vā. Pātimokkhasīlañhi idha ‘‘sīla’’nti adhippetaṃ padhānabhāvato. Rūpādiārammaṇesu abhijjhādīnaṃ pavattinivāraṇasaṅkhātena manacchaṭṭhānaṃ indriyānaṃ pidhānena indriyesu guttadvāro . Pariyesanādivasena bhojane pamāṇajānanena bhojane mattaññū . Vigatathinamiddho hutvā rattindivaṃ kammaṭṭhānamanasikāre yuttatāya jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto . Kathaṃ pana jāgariyānuyogo hotīti taṃ dassetuṃ ‘‘pubbarattā…pe… viharatī’’ ti vuttaṃ. Yathāha ‘‘kathañca pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto hoti? Idha bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi cittaṃ parisodheti, rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena…pe… sodheti, evaṃ kho bhikkhu pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto hotī’’ti (vibha. 519). Imasmiṃ panatthe ti ‘‘maññati, na maññatī’’ti ca vattabbabhāvasaṅkhāte atthe. No puthujjano adhippeto ‘‘appattamānaso, anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamāno’’ti ca vuttattā.
entries.chinese_simplified: “随顺道之圆满者”，是指那从戒等开始，以观(vipassanā)为终，因随顺于导向苦灭的出世间道，故名“随顺道”；由成就此道，故为“圆满者”。今为以个人(puggala)为基准开示此道，故说“具足戒”等。其中，“具足戒”指具足波罗提木叉(pātimokkha)律仪戒，或圆满波罗提木叉戒。此处以“戒”特指波罗提木叉戒，因其为根本。于色等所缘，通过防止贪等生起而关闭以意为第六的诸根，故为“诸根守护门”。通过了知寻求等而于食知量，故为“于食知量”。远离昏沉睡眠，日夜致力于业处作意，故为“勤修警寤”。如何勤修警寤？为开示此，故说“于初夜……乃至……而住”。正如所说：“比丘(bhikkhu)如何于初夜、后夜勤修警寤？兹有比丘，白日以经行、宴坐，从诸障法净化其心；于夜之初分，以经行……乃至……净化其心。比丘如是于初夜、后夜勤修警寤。”“于此义中”，是指在可说为“想”或“不想”的意义上。此处不意指凡夫，因亦说“心未达（阿罗汉），正希求无上瑜伽安稳”。
entries.english: "He is one who fulfills the conforming practice" means that practice which, beginning with virtue and ending with insight, conforms to the supramundane path leading to the cessation of suffering; by accomplishing that, he is one who fulfills it. Now, to illustrate this practice through the individual's standpoint, it is said, "endowed with virtue," etc. Herein, "endowed with virtue" means possessing the virtue of restraint by the Pātimokkha or being complete in the Pātimokkha virtue. For here, "virtue" refers specifically to the Pātimokkha virtue because of its primary importance. "Guarded in the sense faculties" means guarding the doors of the senses by restraining the arising of covetousness and other defilements regarding objects such as forms, by means of the mind, which is the sixth sense faculty. "Knowing moderation in eating" means knowing the proper measure in food with regards to seeking, etc. "Devoted to wakefulness" means being free from sloth and torpor and being diligent in applying himself to the meditation subject day and night. To explain how one is devoted to wakefulness, it is said, "he dwells during the first part of the night..." As it is said: "And how, bhikkhus, is one devoted to wakefulness during the early part and the latter part of the night? Here, a bhikkhu purifies his mind from obstructive states during the day by walking and sitting meditation. In the first watch of the night, he purifies his mind by walking... and so on. Thus, bhikkhus, one is devoted to wakefulness during the early part and the latter part of the night." (Vibh. 519) In this context, "he conceives, he does not conceive" refers to the meaning characterized by the state of being expressible. An ordinary person is not intended here, because it is said, "one who has not attained his mind's aim, aspiring for the unsurpassed security from bondage."

entries.pali: 22 . Saṃvarādīhī ti saṃvarapaṭisevanaadhivāsanaparivajjanavinodanehi. Sabbesampī ti catunnampi ariyamaggānaṃ. Aya nti saṃvarāpahātabbādikathā pubbabhāgapaṭipadāti veditabbā . Tathā hi heṭṭhā ‘‘upakkilesavisodhanaṃ ādiṃ katvā āsavakkhayapaṭipattidassanattha’’nti suttantadesanāya payojanaṃ vuttaṃ. Na hi sakkā ādito eva ariyamaggaṃ bhāvetuṃ, atha kho samādinnasīlo indriyesu guttadvāro ‘‘saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodetī’’ti (dī. ni. 3.348; ma. ni. 2.168) evaṃ vuttaṃ caturāpassenapaṭipattiṃ paṭipajjamāno sammasanavidhiṃ otaritvā anukkamena vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā āsave khepeti. Tenāha bhagavā ‘‘seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro, na āyatakeneva papāto, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, na āyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho’’ti (a. ni. 8.20; udā. 45; cūḷava. 385).
entries.chinese_simplified: 22. “以防护等”是指以防护、受用、忍受、回避、遣除等方式。“于一切”是指于四圣道。此“防护所断”等说，当知为前分行道。正如前文所说，经藏教说的目的是“以净化随烦恼为始，为示现断尽诸漏的行道”。实则无法从一开始就修习圣道，而是须先受持戒律、守护根门，然后“审虑而受用一事，审虑而忍受一事，审虑而回避一事，审虑而遣除一事”，如此实践所述的四种行道，进入省察之法，次第发起观(vipassanā)，依道之次第而灭尽诸漏。是故世尊(Bhagavā)说：“诸比丘，譬如大海，次第向下，次第趋斜，次第深入，而非陡然峭壁。诸比丘，于此法、律中亦复如是，有次第学，有次第作，有次第道，而非顿然了知通达。”
entries.english: 22. 'By restraint, etc.' means by restraint, using, enduring, avoiding, and removing. 'For all' refers to all four noble paths. This discussion on what is to be abandoned by restraint, etc., should be understood as the preliminary part of the practice. For it was stated earlier that the purpose of the Suttanta teaching was 'to show the practice for the destruction of the taints, beginning with the purification of the defilements.' For it is not possible to develop the noble path from the very beginning. Rather, one who has undertaken the virtue, is guarded in the sense-faculties, and undertakes the practice based on the four supports as stated—'One uses something after wise reflection, one endures something after wise reflection, one avoids something after wise reflection, one removes something after wise reflection' (Dī. Ni. 3.348; Ma. Ni. 2.168)—descends into the method of comprehension, gradually develops insight with diligence, and by the sequence of the path, destroys the taints. Therefore the Blessed One said: 'Just as, monks, the great ocean slopes away gradually, inclines gradually, shelves gradually, not with an abrupt precipice, so too, monks, in this Dhamma and Discipline, there is a gradual training, a gradual practice, a gradual path, not an abrupt penetration to final knowledge' (A. Ni. 8.20; Udā. 45; Cūḷava. 385).

entries.pali: ‘‘Sikkhatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā sekkhoti vuccati. Kiñca sikkhati, adhisīlampi sikkhati adhicittampi sikkhati adhipaññampi sikkhati. Sikkhatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā sekkhoti vuccati (a. ni. 3.86). Yopi kalyāṇaputhujjano anulomapaṭipadāya paripūrakārī sīlasampanno indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto pubbarattāpararattaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto viharati ‘ajja vā sve vā aññataraṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ adhigamissāmī’ti, sopi sikkhatīti sekkho’’ti –
entries.chinese_simplified: “比丘，因为学习，所以称为‘有学’。学习什么呢？学习增上戒，学习增上心，也学习增上慧。比丘，因为学习，所以称为‘有学’(A. 3.86)。又，若有善凡夫，行于随顺道，为圆满者，具足戒，守护根门，饮食知量，勤修觉醒，于初夜、后夜，致力于修习菩提分法而住，心想：‘今日或明日，我将证得某一沙门果。’彼亦学习，故为‘有学’。”
entries.english: ‘A bhikkhu is called a “trainee” because he trains. And what does he train in? He trains in the higher virtue, he trains in the higher mind, and he trains in the higher wisdom. A bhikkhu is called a “trainee” because he trains (AN 3.86). Even a virtuous worldling who is fulfilling the conformity-practice, who is accomplished in virtue, with guarded sense faculties, moderate in eating, devoted to wakefulness, and who dwells committed to the development of the qualities pertaining to enlightenment in the first and last watches of the night, thinking, ‘Today or tomorrow I will attain one or another fruit of asceticism’—he too trains, thus he is a trainee.’

entries.pali: Idha bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati (vibha. 508) ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto sātaccaṃ nepakkaṃ bodhipakkhikānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于此，比丘住于波罗提木叉律仪的防护，具足行处与行境，于微细罪过中见其危险，受持学习学处。他守护诸根门，于饮食知量，于初夜后夜勤行觉寤，恒常、审慎，致力于修习菩提分法。
entries.english: Here, a bhikkhu dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint (Vibh. 508), accomplished in conduct and resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults. Having undertaken the training rules, he trains in them. He guards the doors of his sense faculties, is moderate in eating, and is devoted to wakefulness in the early and late watches of the night. He is persistent and prudent, devoted to the development of the qualities that pertain to enlightenment.

entries.pali: Indriyesu guttadvāro ti manacchaṭṭhesu indriyesu rūpādiārammaṇanimittādīnaṃ aggahaṇasaṅkhātasatisaṃvarena pihitadvāro. Bhojane mattaññū ti piṇḍapāte paṭiggahaṇaparibhogesu paccavekkhaṇañāṇavasena ceva appicchatādīhi ca mattajānanako, piṇḍapātavasena cettha catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ gahaṇaṃ veditabbaṃ. Atha vā bhuñjitabbato bhojananti catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ gahaṇaṃ veditabbaṃ. Pubbarattāpararatta nti ettha aḍḍharattisaṅkhātāya rattiyā pubbe pubbarattaṃ, iminā paṭhamayāmañceva pacchābhattañca gaṇhāti. Rattiyā pacchā apararattaṃ, iminā pacchimayāmañceva purebhattañca gaṇhāti. Pacchimayāmo panassa bhikkhuno niddākilamathavinodanokāsoti na gahito.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘于诸根守护门’(indriyesu guttadvāro)，是指于以意为第六的诸根，以不执取色等所缘之相的正念律仪而关闭其门。‘于食知量’(bhojane mattaññū)，是指在领受和食用食物时，以省察智及少欲等而知其量。此处当知，以食物为例，亦包含四资具的受取。或说，因其当受用，故‘食’(bhojana)亦指四资具。‘初夜与后夜’(pubbarattāpararattaṃ)：此处以半夜为界。初夜指半夜之前，此包含初夜分与食后时分；后夜指半夜之后，此包含后夜分与食前时分。而后夜分是比丘消除睡眠疲劳之时机，故不取。
entries.english: 'With sense faculties guarded' means one whose doors are closed in the six sense faculties with mind as the sixth, by the restraint of mindfulness, which consists in not grasping the signs of objects such as forms. 'Knowing moderation in eating' means one who knows the measure in receiving and consuming almsfood, both by way of the knowledge of reflection and by way of having few wishes and so on. Here, by way of almsfood, the taking of the four requisites should be understood. Or, since it is to be eaten, 'eating' should be understood as the taking of the four requisites. In 'the early part of the night and the latter part of the night': here, the early part of the night is what is before midnight; by this is included the first watch and the time after the meal. The latter part of the night is what is after midnight; by this is included the last watch and the time before the meal. But the last watch is not included for this bhikkhu, as it is an occasion for dispelling sleepiness and weariness.
